plan.interpretation: Raw mechanical reconstruction, NOT exact source replication or optimisation. User explicitly requested 1:1 RR.
plan.source_status: A matching secondary repost transcribes 2 ATR, not literal 280R. Original code/complete rules unavailable; reported returns unverified.

rules.timeframe: Completed M5 candles; enter at next available tick, never signal close fill.
rules.vwap: UTC 00:00 daily reset. Sum of completed M5 HLC3 times broker tick volume divided by cumulative tick volume, INCLUDING signal bar. Minimum 15 positive-volume bars. Same anchor on every asset.
rules.signal: First completed close with (VWAP-close)/ATR14 >= 2 while armed; no reversal/bullish/RSI/DI/ADX/news filter.
rules.rearm: After a completed close back inside the 2-ATR boundary or new UTC session. One attempt per excursion; signals while a position is open skipped, no queue.
rules.stop: 1x completed signal M5 ATR14 below requested ask entry; rounded to nearest broker tick.
rules.target: 1x actual requested-entry-to-rounded-stop distance above requested ask entry. Fixed 1R, NOT a full return to VWAP.
rules.session: All broker tradable sessions, entries through 23:50 UTC; flat on first available tick >=23:55 UTC, or next UTC day if no closing tick. Crypto weekends included.
rules.management: No trailing, partials, breakeven, pyramiding or opposite-side hedge. One open position per independent asset account.
rules.sizing: 1% current closed balance nominal stop risk. OrderCalcProfit converts to USD; floor broker lot step. Skip below minimum size, invalid stops or margin constraint.
rules.costs: Native broker bid/ask, commission, swap and 150ms delay. Stops/targets sent with order relative to requested quote; realised R can differ due to fills/gaps/costs.

limitations: Timeframe, ATR period/stop, VWAP/session anchor, warmup, rearming and time exit are reconstruction assumptions.
Broker tick volume is not consolidated exchange traded volume, including on crypto CFDs; not NQ futures replication.
Older real-tick availability varies by asset and is disclosed; Model4 can include generated ticks.
One frozen parameter set on all assets; no best-parameter search, holdout claim or live promotion.
Individual independently funded accounts, not summed or shared portfolio results. Nominal 1% risk is not a guaranteed maximum loss.
